text: 0-dimensional biomaterials show inductive properties.
reference_answer: 0-dimensional biomaterials show inductive properties.

text: 1,000 genomes project enables mapping of genetic sequence variation consisting of rare variants with larger penetrance effects than common variants.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: 1/2000 in UK have abnormal PrP positivity.
reference_answer: The evidence shows a prevalence of about 493 per million (≈1 in 2,000) UK individuals with abnormal PrP positivity.

text: 5% of perinatal mortality is due to low birth weight.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: A deficiency of vitamin B12 increases blood levels of homocysteine.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: A high microerythrocyte count raises vulnerability to severe anemia in homozygous alpha (+)- thalassemia trait subjects.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; a high microerythrocyte count in homozygous α⁺‑thalassemia actually helps protect against severe anemia.

text: A total of 1,000 people in the UK are asymptomatic carriers of vCJD infection.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim because the study estimates a prevalence of 493 per million, implying tens of thousands of asymptomatic carriers in the UK, far more than 1,000.

text: ADAR1 binds to Dicer to cleave pre-miRNA.
reference_answer: ADAR1 binds Dicer and promotes cleavage of pre‑miRNA.

text: AIRE is expressed in some skin tumors.
reference_answer: AIRE is expressed in some skin tumors.

text: ALDH1 expression is associated with better breast cancer outcomes.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; ALDH1 correlates with poor prognosis.

text: ALDH1 expression is associated with poorer prognosis in breast cancer.
reference_answer: The evidence supports that ALDH1 expression is associated with poorer prognosis in breast cancer.

text: AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) activation increases inflammation-related fibrosis in the lungs.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; AMPK activation reduces fibrosis.

text: APOE4 expression in iPSC-derived neurons increases AlphaBeta production and tau phosphorylation causing GABA neuron degeneration.
reference_answer: The evidence supports the claim that APOE4 expression in iPSC-derived neurons increases Aβ production and tau phosphorylation, leading to GABA neuron degeneration.

text: APOE4 expression in iPSC-derived neurons increases AlphaBeta production and tau phosphorylation, delaying GABA neuron degeneration.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; APOE4 expression increases Aβ production and tau phosphorylation and causes GABA neuron degeneration rather than delaying it.

text: Activation of PPM1D suppresses p53 function.
reference_answer: Activation of PPM1D suppresses p53 function.

text: Activator-inhibitor pairs are provided dorsally by Admpchordin.
reference_answer: Activator‑inhibitor pairs are provided dorsally by ADMP and Chordin.

text: Active H. pylori urease has a polymeric structure that compromises two subunits, UreA and UreB.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Albendazole is used to treat lymphatic filariasis.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Alizarin forms hydrogen bonds with residues involved in PGAM1 substrate binding.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: All hematopoietic stem cells segregate their chromosomes randomly.
reference_answer: The evidence supports the claim: all hematopoietic stem cells segregate their chromosomes randomly.

text: Angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitors are associated with increased risk for functional renal insufficiency.
reference_answer: ACE inhibitors are associated with increased risk for functional renal insufficiency.

text: Anthrax spores can be disposed of easily after they are dispersed.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; spores readily reaerosolize, hindering easy disposal.

text: Antibiotic induced alterations in the gut microbiome reduce resistance against Clostridium difficile
reference_answer: Antibiotic‑induced alterations in the gut microbiome reduce resistance against C. difficile.

text: Antiretroviral therapy reduces rates of tuberculosis across a broad range of CD4 strata.
reference_answer: Antiretroviral therapy reduces tuberculosis incidence across all CD4 count strata.

text: Arginine 90 in p150n is important for interaction with EB1.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Arterioles have a larger lumen diameter than venules.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Articles published in open access format are less likely to be cited than traditional journals.

text: Articles published in open access format are more likely to be cited than traditional journals.
reference_answer: Articles published in open access format are more likely to be cited than traditional journals.

text: Aspirin inhibits the production of PGE2.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Assembly of invadopodia is triggered by focal generation of phosphatidylinositol-3,4-biphosphate and the activation of the nonreceptor tyrosine kinase Src.
reference_answer: Assembly of invadopodia is triggered by focal PtdIns(3,4)P2 generation and Src activation.

text: Asymptomatic visual impairment screening in elderly populations does not lead to improved vision.
reference_answer: The evidence supports the claim that screening asymptomatic older adults for visual impairment does not improve vision.

text: Auditory entrainment is strengthened when people see congruent visual and auditory information.
reference_answer: Auditory entrainment is strengthened when people see congruent visual and auditory information.

text: Autologous transplantation of mesenchymal stem cells causes a higher rate of opportunistic infections than induction therapy with anti-interleukin-2 receptor antibodies.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Autologous transplantation of mesenchymal stem cells causes fewer opportunistic infections than induction therapy with anti-interleukin-2 receptor antibodies.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Autologous transplantation of mesenchymal stem cells has lower rates of rejection than induction therapy with anti-interleukin-2 receptor antibodies.
reference_answer: The evidence shows that autologous MSC transplantation results in lower acute rejection rates than anti‑IL‑2 receptor antibody induction therapy.

text: Autophagy declines in aged organisms.
reference_answer: The evidence supports that autophagy declines in aged organisms.

text: Bariatric surgery has a positive impact on mental health.
reference_answer: Bariatric surgery improves mental health, reducing depression prevalence and severity.

text: Basophils counteract disease development in patients with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE).
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; basophils promote lupus nephritis.

text: Birth-weight is positively associated with breast cancer.
reference_answer: Higher birth weight is associated with increased breast cancer risk.

text: Blocking the interaction between TDP-43 and respiratory complex I proteins ND3 and ND6 leads to increased TDP-43-induced neuronal loss.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, showing that blocking TDP‑43’s interaction with ND3 and ND6 (by suppressing its mitochondrial localization) actually prevents TDP‑43‑induced neuronal loss.

text: Bone marrow cells contribute to adult macrophage compartments.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, showing that adult tissue macrophage compartments are maintained locally with minimal contribution from bone marrow‑derived cells.

text: Breast cancer development is determined exclusively by genetic factors.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: CCL19 is absent within dLNs.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: CHEK2 is not associated with breast cancer.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; a rare CHEK2 1100delC mutation shows elevated breast cancer risk.

text: CR is associated with higher methylation age.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, showing that caloric restriction is linked to a younger (lower) methylation age rather than a higher one.

text: CRP is not predictive of postoperative mortality following Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG) surgery.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: CX3CR1 on the Th2 cells impairs T cell survival
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; CX3CR1 signaling promotes TH2 cell survival rather than impairing it.

text: CX3CR1 on the Th2 cells promotes T cell survival
reference_answer: CX3CR1 on Th2 cells promotes T cell survival.

text: CX3CR1 on the Th2 cells promotes airway inflammation.
reference_answer: CX3CR1 on Th2 cells promotes airway inflammation.

text: CX3CR1 on the Th2 cells suppresses airway inflammation.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; CX3CR1 on Th2 cells promotes, rather than suppresses, airway inflammation.

text: Carriers of the alcohol aldehyde dehydrogenase deficiency mutation drink less that non-carries.
reference_answer: Carriers of the ALDH2 deficiency mutation drink considerably less alcohol than non‑carriers.

text: Cataract and trachoma are the primary cause of blindness in Southern Sudan.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Cell autonomous sex determination in somatic cells does not occur in Galliformes.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; chicken somatic cells show cell‑autonomous sex identity.

text: Cell autonomous sex determination in somatic cells occurs in Passeriformes.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Cells lacking clpC have a defect in sporulation efficiency in Bacillus subtilis.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Cells undergoing methionine restriction may activate miRNAs.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Cellular aging closely links to an older appearance.
reference_answer: Cellular aging closely links to an older appearance.

text: Chenodeosycholic acid treatment increases whole-body energy expenditure.
reference_answer: Chenodeoxycholic acid treatment increases whole-body energy expenditure.

text: Chenodeosycholic acid treatment reduces whole-body energy expenditure.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; CDCA treatment actually increased whole-body energy expenditure.

text: Chronic aerobic exercise alters endothelial function, improving vasodilating mechanisms mediated by NO.
reference_answer: The evidence supports that chronic aerobic exercise improves endothelial NO‑mediated vasodilation.

text: Cold exposure increases BAT recruitment.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Cold exposure reduces BAT recruitment.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Combination nicotine replacement therapies with varenicline or bupropion lead to significantly higher long-term abstinence rates at 52 weeks than varenicline monotherapy.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; higher abstinence at 52 weeks was not statistically significant.

text: Combining phosphatidylinositide 3-kinase and MEK 1/2 inhibitors is effective at treating KRAS mutant tumors.
reference_answer: Combining PI3K and MEK inhibitors was shown to synergistically shrink KRAS‑mutant tumors.

text: Commelina yellow mottle virus' (ComYMV) genome consists of 7489 baise pairs.
reference_answer: The evidence confirms that the Commelina yellow mottle virus genome is 7,489 base pairs long.

text: Crossover hot spots are not found within gene promoters in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Crosstalk between dendritic cells (DCs) and innate lymphoid cells (ILCs) is important in the regulation of intestinal homeostasis.
reference_answer: Crosstalk between dendritic cells and ILCs is important for regulating intestinal homeostasis.

text: Cytochrome c is released from the mitochondrial intermembrane space to cytosol during apoptosis.
reference_answer: Cytochrome c is released from the mitochondrial intermembrane space into the cytosol during apoptosis.

text: Cytosolic proteins bind to iron-responsive elements on mRNAs coding for DMT1. Cytosolic proteins bind to iron-responsive elements on mRNAs coding for proteins involved in iron uptake.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: DMRT1 is a sex-determining gene that is epigenetically regulated by the MHM region.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: De novo assembly of sequence data has more specific contigs than unassembled sequence data.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Deamination of cytidine to uridine on the minus strand of viral DNA results in catastrophic G-to-A mutations in the viral genome.
reference_answer: APOBEC3G deaminates cytidine on the minus strand, causing catastrophic G‑to‑A mutations.

text: Deleting Raptor reduces G-CSF levels.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Deletion of αvβ8 does not result in a spontaneous inflammatory phenotype.
reference_answer: Deletion of αvβ8 does not result in a spontaneous inflammatory phenotype.

text: Dexamethasone decreases risk of postoperative bleeding.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; dexamethasone increased postoperative bleeding risk.

text: Diabetic patients with acute coronary syndrome experience increased short-term and long-term risk for bleeding events.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Discrimination between the initiator and elongation tRNAs depends on the translation initiation factor IF3.
reference_answer: The evidence supports the claim that discrimination between initiator and elongation tRNAs depends on translation initiation factor IF3.

text: Downregulation and mislocalization of Scribble prevents cell transformation and mammary tumorigenesis.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; downregulation and mislocalization of Scribble promote transformation and tumorigenesis.

text: During the primary early antibody response activated B cells migrate toward the inner-and outer paracortical areas where oxysterol accumulation is generated by stromal cells.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Enhanced early production of inflammatory chemokines improves viral control in the lung.
reference_answer: Early increased production of inflammatory chemokines by memory CD4⁺ T cells enhances viral control in the lung.

text: Epidemiological disease burden from noncommunicable diseases is more prevalent in low economic settings.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, showing that risk factors for noncommunicable diseases such as high BMI and high fasting plasma glucose actually increase with higher Socio‑demographic Index (i.e., higher economic settings).

text: Epigenetic modulating agents (EMAs) modulate antitumor immune response in a cancer model system.
reference_answer: Epigenetic modulating agents modulate the antitumor immune response in mouse cancer models.

text: Errors in peripheral IV drug administration are most common during bolus administration and multiple-step medicine preparations.
reference_answer: Errors in peripheral IV drug administration are most common during bolus administration and multiple‑step medicine preparations.

text: Ethanol stress decreases the expression of IBP in bacteria.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Exposure to fine particulate air pollution is relate to anxiety prevalence.
reference_answer: The evidence shows that higher exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) is associated with increased prevalence of anxiety symptoms.

text: Febrile seizures increase the threshold for development of epilepsy.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; febrile seizures cause lasting excitability changes and are not benign, implying increased epilepsy risk.

text: Febrile seizures reduce the threshold for development of epilepsy.
reference_answer: The evidence supports that febrile seizures reduce the threshold for development of epilepsy.

text: Female carriers of the Apolipoprotein E4 (APOE4) allele have increased risk for dementia.
reference_answer: Female carriers of the APOE4 allele have an increased risk of dementia.

text: Flexible molecules experience greater steric hindrance in the tumor microenviroment than rigid molecules.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: FoxO3a activation in neuronal death is mediated by reactive oxygen species (ROS).
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, showing that ROS-induced FOXO3 activation promotes stress resistance and inhibits cell death rather than mediating neuronal death.

text: Free histones are degraded by a Rad53-dependent mechanism once DNA has been replicated.
reference_answer: The evidence supports the claim that free histones are degraded by a Rad53‑dependent mechanism.

text: Functional consequences of genomic alterations due to Myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) are poorly understood due to the lack of an animal model.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Fz/PCP-dependent Pk localizes to the anterior membrane of neuroectoderm cells during zebrafish neuralation
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Fz/PCP-dependent Pk localizes to the anterior membrane of notochord cells during zebrafish neuralation.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: GATA-3 is important for hematopoietic stem cell (HSC) function.
reference_answer: The evidence shows that GATA‑3 is required for maintaining normal numbers of HSCs and for their entry into the cell cycle, confirming its importance for HSC function.

text: Gene expression does not vary appreciably across genetically identical cells.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; gene expression is stochastic, producing cell‑to‑cell variation even among genetically identical cells.

text: Glycolysis is one of the primary glycometabolic pathways in cells.
reference_answer: Glycolysis is indeed a primary glycometabolic pathway in cells.

text: Golli-deficient T-cells prefer to differentiate into an anergic phenotype in the adaptive immune response when there are increased levels of Ca2+ in the cytosol.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: HNF4A mutations can cause diabetes in mutant carriers by the age of 14 years
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Headaches are not correlated with cognitive impairment.
reference_answer: The study found no evidence that headaches are associated with cognitive impairment.

text: Healthcare delivery efficiency in crowded delivery centers is impaired by improving structural, logistical, and interpersonal elements.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Helminths interfere with immune system control of macrophages activated by IL-4 favor Mycobacterium tuberculosis replication.
reference_answer: Helminth‑induced Th2 cytokines like IL‑4 impair macrophage autophagy, reducing control of Mycobacterium tuberculosis and favoring its replication.

text: Hematopoietic Stem Cell purification reaches purity rate of up to 50%.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: High cardiopulmonary fitness causes increased mortality rate.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, showing that low cardiopulmonary fitness—not high fitness—is associated with increased cardiovascular risk factors and mortality.

text: High dietary calcium intakes are unnecessary for prevention of secondary hyperparathyroidism in subjects with 25(OH)D levels above 75 nmol/liter.
reference_answer: High dietary calcium intakes are unnecessary for prevention of secondary hyperparathyroidism in subjects with 25(OH)D levels above 75 nmol/L.

text: High levels of CRP reduces the risk of exacerbations in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim and shows that high CRP levels are associated with an increased risk of COPD exacerbations.

text: High levels of copeptin decrease risk of diabetes.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: High-sensitivity cardiac troponin T (HSCT-T) dosage may not be diagnostic if the onset of symptoms occurs less than 3 hours before acute myocardial injury (AMI).
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Histone demethylase recruitment and a transient decrease in histone methylation is necessary for ligand-dependent induction of transcription by nuclear receptors.
reference_answer: Histone demethylase recruitment and the resulting transient loss of inhibitory histone methylation are required for ligand‑dependent transcriptional activation by nuclear receptors.

text: Homozygous deletion of murine Sbds gene from osterix-expressing mesenchymal stem and progenitor cells (MPCs) prevents oxidative stress.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; Sbds deletion induces oxidative stress.

text: Human T-lymphotropic virus type-I-associated myelopathy / tropical spastic paraparesis (HAM/TSP) patients produce Immunoglobulin G (IgG) antibodies which cross-react with an immunodominant epitope in Tax.
reference_answer: HAM/TSP patients produce IgG antibodies that cross‑react with an immunodominant epitope in the HTLV‑1 Tax protein.

text: Hyperfibrinogenemia decreases rates of femoropopliteal bypass thrombosis.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; higher plasma fibrinogen levels were linked to lower graft patency and higher occlusion rates.

text: Hyperfibrinogenemia increases rates of femoropopliteal bypass thrombosis.
reference_answer: High plasma fibrinogen levels are associated with increased femoropopliteal bypass graft occlusion.

text: Hypertension is frequently observed in type 1 diabetes patients.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Hypocretin neurones induce panicprone state in rats.
reference_answer: Hypocretin neurons induce a panic‑prone state in rats.

text: Hypoglycemia increases the risk of dementia.
reference_answer: Hypoglycemia increases the risk of dementia.

text: Hypothalamic glutamate neurotransmission is crucial to energy balance.
reference_answer: The evidence shows that hypothalamic glutamate release from VMH neurons is essential for regulating glucose homeostasis and feeding, confirming its crucial role in energy balance.

text: IFIT1 restricts viral replication by sequestrating mis-capped viral RNAs.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: IRG1 has antiviral effects against neurotropic viruses.
reference_answer: IRG1 exhibits antiviral activity against neurotropic viruses.

text: ITAM phosphorylation prevents the transfer of the T cell receptor (TCR) signal from the echo-domain to the cytoplasmic tail of the T cell receptor (TCR).
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: IgA plasma cells that are specific for transglutaminase 2 accumulate in the duodenal mucosa on commencement of a gluten-free diet.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Immune complex triggered cell death leads to extracellular release of neutrophil protein HMGB1.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Immune responses result in the development of inflammatory Th17 cells and anti-inflammatory iTregs.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: In adult tissue, most T cells are memory T cells.
reference_answer: In adult tissue, most T cells are memory T cells.

text: In domesticated populations of Saccharomyces cerevisiae, whole chromosome aneuploidy is very uncommon.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: In mice, P. chabaudi parasites are able to proliferate faster early in infection when inoculated at lower numbers than when inoculated at high numbers.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; innate responses saturate with parasite dose, indicating higher inocula grow faster early in infection.

text: In mouse models, the loss of CSF1R facilitates MOZ-TIF2-induced leuekmogenesis.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; CSF1R loss suppresses MOZ‑TIF2‑induced AML.

text: In transgenic mice harboring green florescent protein under the control of the Sox2 promoter, less than ten percent of the cells with green florescent colocalize with cell proliferation markers.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: In young and middle-aged adults, current or remote uses of ADHD medications do not increase the risk of serious cardiovascular events.
reference_answer: Current and remote ADHD medication use does not increase serious cardiovascular event risk.

text: Incidence of heart failure decreased by 10% in women since 1979.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; it found that the incidence of heart failure in women did not decline since 1979.

text: Incidence rates of cervical cancer have decreased.
reference_answer: Incidence rates of cervical cancer have decreased.

text: Incidence rates of cervical cancer have increased due to nationwide screening programs based primarily on cytology to detect uterine cervical cancer.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, showing that incidence rates have declined rather than increased with cytology‑based screening programs.

text: Increased microtubule acetylation repairs LRRK2 Roc-COR domain mutation induced locomotor deficits.
reference_answer: Increased microtubule acetylation repairs LRRK2 Roc‑COR domain mutation induced locomotor deficits.

text: Increased vessel density along with a reduction in fibrosis decreases the efficacy of chemotherapy treatments.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; increased vessel density improves chemotherapy efficacy.

text: Individuals with low serum vitamin D concentrations have increased risk of multiple sclerosis.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Infection of human T-cell lymphotropic virus type 1 is most frequent in individuals of African origin.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim and shows HTLV‑I infection is endemic in Japan, the Caribbean, Africa and Melanesia, not most frequent solely in individuals of African origin.

text: Inositol lipid 3-phosphatase PTEN converts Ptdlns(3,4)P 2 into phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate.
reference_answer: PTEN acts as a PI(3,4)P₂ 3‑phosphatase, converting PI(3,4)P₂ into phosphatidylinositol 4‑phosphate.

text: Input from  mental and physical health care professionals is effective at decreasing homelessness.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Insomnia can be effectively treated with cognitive behavioral therapy.
reference_answer: CBT effectively improves insomnia, enhancing sleep efficiency and long‑term outcomes.

text: Insulin increases risk of severe kidney failure.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Integrating classroom-based collaborative learning with Web-based collaborative learning leads to subpar class performance
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Ivermectin is used to treat lymphatic filariasis.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Ivermectin is used to treat onchocerciasis.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: LDL cholesterol has no involvement in the development of cardiovascular disease.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, showing that LDL cholesterol has a causal role in the development of cardiovascular disease.

text: Lack of clpC does not affect sporulation efficiency in Bacillus subtilis cells.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Less than 10% of the gabonese children with Schimmelpenning-Feuerstein-Mims syndrome (SFM) had a plasma lactate of more than 5mmol/L.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Leukemia associated Rho guanine nucleotide-exchange factor represses RhoA in response to SRC activation.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; LARG is activated by Src family kinase Fyn, not shown to repress RhoA.

text: Leuko-increased blood increases infectious complications in red blood cell transfusion.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; leukoreduction did not lower infection rates.

text: Leuko-reduced blood reduces infectious complications in red blood cell transfusion.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; infections were not reduced.

text: Localization of PIN1 in the Arabidopsis embryo does not require VPS9a
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Localization of PIN1 in the roots of Arabidopsis does not require VPS9a
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Low expression of miR7a does represses target genes and exerts a biological function in ovaries.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Low expression of miR7a exerts a biological function in testis.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Low nucleosome occupancy correlates with low methylation levels across species.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; it shows that dense methylation occurs in nucleosome linkers (low nucleosome occupancy), indicating low nucleosome occupancy correlates with high, not low, methylation levels.

text: Lupus-prone mice infected with curliproducing bacteria have higher autoantibody titers compared to controls.
reference_answer: Lupus‑prone mice infected with curli‑producing bacteria show higher autoantibody titers than controls.

text: Ly49Q directs the organization of neutrophil migration to inflammation sites by regulating membrane raft functions.
reference_answer: Ly49Q directs neutrophil migration to inflammation sites by regulating membrane raft functions.

text: Ly6C hi monocytes have a lower inflammatory capacity compared to their Ly6C lo counterparts.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Ly6C hi monocytes have a lower inflammatory capacity than Ly6C lo monocytes.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; Ly6C hi monocytes are increased and preferentially recruited during inflammation, indicating a higher inflammatory capacity than Ly6C lo monocytes.

text: Lymphadenopathy is observed in knockin mouse lacking the SHP-2 MAPK pathway.
reference_answer: Lymphadenopathy is observed in knockin mice lacking SHP‑2 signaling.

text: Macrolides have no protective effect against myocardial infarction.
reference_answer: The study found no protective effect of macrolide use on the risk of first-time acute myocardial infarction.

text: Macrolides protect against myocardial infarction.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; the study found no protective effect of macrolides on myocardial infarction risk.

text: Macropinocytosis contributes to a cell's supply of amino acids via the intracellular uptake of protein.
reference_answer: Macropinocytosis contributes to a cell’s supply of amino acids via intracellular protein uptake.

text: Many proteins in human cells can be post-translationally modified at lysine residues via acetylation.
reference_answer: Many proteins in human cells are post‑translationally modified at lysine residues by acetylation.

text: Mathematical models predict that using Artemisinin-based combination therapy over nongametocytocidal drugs have a dramatic impact in reducing malaria transmission.
reference_answer: Mathematical models predict that ACTs, compared with nongametocytocidal drugs, can dramatically reduce malaria transmission.

text: Mercaptopurine is anabolized into the inactive methylmercaptopurine by thiopurine methyltrasnferase (TPMT).
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Metastatic colorectal cancer treated with a single agent fluoropyrimidines resulted in reduced efficacy and lower quality of life when compared with oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy in elderly patients.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; the trial found no significant difference in quality of life and only a non‑significant trend toward better progression‑free survival with oxaliplatin‑based therapy.

text: Mice defective for deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) polymerase I (polI) reveal increased sensitivity to ionizing radiation (IR).
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Mice that lack Interferon-γ or its receptor exhibit high resistance to experimental autoimmune myocarditis.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; mice lacking IFN‑γ or its receptor are more susceptible, not resistant, to experimental autoimmune myocarditis.

text: Mice without IFN-γ or its receptor are resistant to EAM induced with α-MyHC/CFA.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; IFN‑γ‑deficient mice develop fatal autoimmune myocarditis.

text: MicroRNA is involved in the regulation of Neural Stem Cell (NSC) differentiation and proliferation dynamic homeostasis
reference_answer: MicroRNA is involved in the regulation of NSC differentiation and proliferation homeostasis.

text: Microarray results from culture-amplified mixtures of serotypes correlate poorly with microarray results from uncultured mixtures.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Mitochondria are uninvolved in apoptosis.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, showing that mitochondria do participate in apoptosis.

text: Modifying the epigenome in the brain affects the normal human aging process by affecting certain genes related to neurogenesis.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Monoclonal antibody targeting of N-cadherin inhibits metastasis.
reference_answer: Monoclonal antibody targeting of N‑cadherin inhibits metastasis.

text: Most termination events in Okazaki fragments are sequence specific.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; termination is largely passive and not sequence specific.

text: Mutant mice lacking SVCT2 have greatly increased ascorbic acid levels in both brain and adrenals.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Mutations in G-Beta protein GNB2 are present in many cancers, resulting in loss of interaction with G-alpha subunits and concomitant activation of AKT pathway.
reference_answer: The evidence supports the claim that GNB2 mutations occur in many cancers, disrupt G‑alpha binding, and activate downstream AKT signaling.

text: N-terminal cleavage increases success identifying transcription start sites.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: N-terminal cleavage reduces success identifying transcription start sites.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: N348I mutations cause resistance to zidovudine (AZT).
reference_answer: N348I mutations confer resistance to zidovudine (AZT).

text: NF2 (Merlin) causes phosphorylation and subsequent cytoplasmic sequestration of YAP in Drosophila by activating LATS1/2 kinases.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: NF2 (Merlin) prevents phosphorylation and subsequent cytoplasmic sequestration of YAP in Drosophila.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: NFAT4 activation requires IP3R-mediated Ca2+ mobilization.
reference_answer: NFAT4 activation indeed requires IP3R-mediated Ca²⁺ mobilization.

text: NOX2-independent pathways can generate peroxynitrite by reacting with nitrogen intermediates.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: NR5A2 is important in development of endometrial tissues.
reference_answer: NR5A2 is essential for endometrial development, including decidualization.

text: Nanoparticles can be targeted against specific cell types by incorporating aptamers into lipid nanoparticles.
reference_answer: Aptamer-functionalized lipid nanoparticles can be directed to specific cell types, such as osteoblasts, enabling targeted delivery.

text: Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) are released by ANCA-stimulated neutrophils.
reference_answer: The evidence supports that ANCA-stimulated neutrophils release neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs).

text: New drugs for tuberculosis often do not penetrate the necrotic portion of a tuberculosis lesion in high concentrations.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Non-invasive ventilation use should be decreased if there is inadequate response to conventional treatment.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Normal expression of RUNX1 has tumor-promoting effects.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim; it shows RUNX1 acts as a tumor suppressor, not a tumor promoter.

text: Obesity decreases life quality.
reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Obesity is determined solely by environmental factors.
reference_answer: The evidence contradicts the claim, showing that genetics, not just environment, plays a substantial role in obesity.

text: Occupancy of ribosomes by IncRNAs do not make functional peptides.

text: PDPN promotes efficient motility along stromal surfaces by activating the C-type lectin receptor to rearrange the actin cytoskeleton in dendritic cells.

text: PGE 2 promotes intestinal tumor growth by altering the expression of tumor suppressing and DNA repair genes.

reference_answer: The evidence supports the claim that PKG‑I (PKG‑la) is essential for the expression of pain hypersensitivity, as mice lacking PKG‑I show marked defects in activity‑induced nociceptive hypersensitivity.

reference_answer: The evidence is insufficient.

text: Participating in six months of physical activity improves cognitive functioning.

text: Peroxynitrite is required for nitration of TCR/CD8.
reference_answer: Peroxynitrite is required for nitration of TCR/CD8.

text: Pleiotropic coupling of GLP-1R to intracellular effectors promotes distinct profiles of cellular signaling.
reference_answer: Pleiotropic coupling of GLP‑1R to intracellular effectors promotes distinct profiles of cellular signaling.

text: Podocytes are motile and migrate in the presence of injury.

text: Polymeal nutrition reduces cardiovascular mortality.

text: Pretreatment with the Arp2/3 inhibitor CK-666 affects lamelliopodia formation.

text: Primary pro-inflammatory cytokines induce secondary pro- and anti-inflammatory mediators.

text: Pseudogene PTENP1 regulates the expression of PTEN by functioning as an miRNA decoy.

text: Teaching hospitals do not provide better care than non-teaching hospitals.

reference_answer: Tetraspanin‑3 is a causative factor in the development of acute myelogenous leukemia.
